heroHeadline: Mecca Pact Still Untested: Pakistan Leans on Diplomacy, Not Invocation, as Hormuz Crisis Continues
heroSubtitle: Tracking signatories, accession candidates, treaty terms, and regional reactions — a week after the Sidr tanker attack, Pakistan's FM has held follow-up calls with his Saudi and Turkish counterparts on the Istanbul committee's agenda, but neither Islamabad nor Ankara has invoked the pact's mutual-defense clause.
